package.welcome_message: Welcome to a 3-day Jordan adventure through Amman, Petra, and Wadi Rum - curated with authentic Jordanian experiences and local guides.

trip.title: Amman • Petra • Wadi Rum
trip.summary: Three days of historic exploration and desert photography, each day staying in one region: Amman, Petra, then Wadi Rum. Morning visits to outdoor sites, afternoons for shade, meals, and indoor attractions.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Amman, Petra, then Wadi Rum. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting and confusing.

days.summary: Arrive, enjoy a relaxed dinner, and settle into a downtown hotel near the airport.

schedule.name: Cantaloupe Gastro Pub
schedule.description: A sophisticated rooftop gastro pub in Jabal Amman offering stunning citadel views, gourmet bites, and craft cocktails.
schedule.reason: A convenient meal after landing, with panoramic views to ease jet-lag and set the tone for the trip.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Art Hotel Downtown
schedule.description: Recently refurbished three-star hotel at 30 King Faisal Street in Downtown Amman with a terrace, on-site restaurant, and easy access to the Citadel.
schedule.reason: Close to the airport and city center, providing a comfortable rest after travel.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

days.transport_notes: Land in Amman, eat nearby, then rest at your hotel.

days.summary: Explore Petra's iconic sites, enjoy a Bedouin tea break, and finish with a fine-dining experience before checking into a local hotel.

schedule.name: Al-Khazneh (The Treasury)
schedule.description: An iconic ancient Nabataean rock-cut temple façade carved into the rose-red sandstone cliff face at Petra.
schedule.reason: A must-see Petra landmark that offers dramatic photography and deep historical context.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Al-Maddras Trail & High Viewpoint
schedule.description: An ancient alternative entry trail into Petra featuring sacred rock carvings and elevated perspectives.
schedule.reason: Provides a less-crowded route with unique photographic opportunities and cultural insight.

schedule.name: Bedouin Cave Cafe
schedule.description: Rustic teahouse located inside Petra archaeological park near the Treasury view points.
schedule.reason: A quick, authentic Bedouin tea break that complements the morning's archaeological exploration.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Little Petra Triclinium & Painted House
schedule.description: A famous interior rock chamber within Little Petra featuring rare 2,000-year-old Nabataean ceiling frescoes.
schedule.reason: An indoor, shaded site ideal for a hot afternoon, offering rich cultural and photographic value.
matched_preferences: Indoor option on a hot day
One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Crown Plaza Basin Restaurant
schedule.description: Historic restaurant located inside the Petra Archaeological Park near the start of the Monastery trail.
schedule.reason: A refined dining experience that showcases local flavors after a day of exploration.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Nomads Hotel Petra
schedule.description: Independent hostel-hotel on Touristic Street with around 49 rooms, a rooftop bar with mountain and sunset views, and a games room.
schedule.reason: Convenient overnight stay in Petra, allowing easy access to the next day's sites.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

days.transport_notes: This evening you check in to your hotel in Petra.

days.summary: Discover Wadi Rum's desert heritage, enjoy a rest house lunch, and finish with a Bedouin camp dinner under the stars.

schedule.name: Wadi Rum Visitor Center
schedule.description: The main operational gateway and orientation center for the UNESCO-listed Wadi Rum Protected Area.
schedule.reason: A quick orientation to the desert's layout and cultural significance, ideal for a morning visit.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Al-Khazali Mountain Petroglyphs
schedule.description: An extensive concentration of ancient Thamudic and Safaitic petroglyphs carved on Jebel Khazali cliffs.
schedule.reason: A compact, high-value photographic site showcasing desert rock art.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Wadi Rum Visitor Center Rest House
schedule.description: Historical rest house and eatery located at Rum Village entrance, serving travelers and desert trekkers since the 1980s.
schedule.reason: A convenient lunch spot with local flavors, positioned near the visitor center.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Nabataean Temple of Wadi Rum
schedule.description: The stone ruins of a 1st-century BC Nabataean temple dedicated to goddess Allat near Rum Village.
schedule.reason: An iconic, easily accessible ruin that offers rich historical context and photographic appeal.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Captain's Desert Camp Restaurant Wadi Rum
schedule.description: Established desert camp restaurant in Wadi Rum Protected Area serving traditional Bedouin buffet dinners around central campfires.
schedule.reason: A memorable desert dining experience that complements the day's cultural exploration.
